prompt_en: Cinematic editorial photograph of an unmistakably adult woman in her mid-twenties wearing a flowing white dress, caught in the instant of falling away from a coastal cliff above dark turquoise surf. Her body is fully suspended in open air; wind lifts her dress and black hair as the cliff recedes above. She turns a tender, disturbingly calm smile toward the same adult figure at the cliff edge and reaches one hand back toward that figure's outstretched hand; matching thin red bracelets identify their bond. A single tear has just escaped beneath her smile, blown upward by the fall. Her brow stays relaxed, her eyelids soft, and her small closed-lip smile remains serene rather than alarmed. It glints under one eye. Their fingertips have separated. A taut red thread unravels between the bracelets, making the widening distance visible. Freeze the unresolved descent before impact in pale overcast sea spray with sharp facial detail. Use a diagonal full-body frame from slightly below and offshore, leaving a vast column of air beneath her. Soft silver backlight isolates her white silhouette against the sea.
